build_equivariant_layer_norm: build a python module to create an EquivariantLayerNormArray for normalizing features of shape N sphere_basis C
build_spherical_harmonics_norm: build a python module to create an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics for normalizing L=0 separately and L>0 together
build_rms_norm_v2: build a python module to create an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 with centering and degree balancing
build_factory_norm_layer: build a python module to use get_normalization_layer factory to instantiate layer_norm_sh or rms_norm_sh
build_degree_layer_scale: build a python module to create an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale that scales higher degrees by inverse sqrt of 2L
